segments.text:
1 What Baptiſme is.
2 What are the ends of Baptiſme: or for what it was inſtituted.
3 What is the ſenſe and meaning of the words of the inſtitution thereof.
4 What are the formes and kindes of ſpeaking of Baptiſme.
5 Who are to be baptized.
6 The lawful and right vſe of Baptiſme.
7 In place whereof Baptiſme did ſucceede.
8 Howe Baptiſme agreeth with circumciſion, and in what is differeth from it.
